we introduce TopicGPT, a human-centric approach to topic modeling that relies on prompting large language models to perform in-context topic generation ( §3.1) and assignment ( §3.2). First, we iteratively prompt an LLM to generate new topics given a sample of documents from an input dataset and a list of previously generated topics.
